title: Nano Banana Infographic Creator Output Schema
description: Output format for Nano Banana optimized infographic/slide illustration prompts. The LLM returns this JSON structure after processing user inputs.

prompt.description: Complete Nano Banana optimized prompt following the formula: [CONTENT TYPE] + [VISUAL STYLE] + [LAYOUT & COMPOSITION] + [COLOR SCHEME] + [TYPOGRAPHY HINTS] + [TECHNICAL SPECS]. For Google Search grounding, uses two-step format.

model.description: Nano Banana model selected (auto-resolved to specific model)

colorScheme.description: Color palette used in the design

background.description: Background color or description (e.g., '#FFFFFF', 'white', 'warm office tones')

layoutDescription.description: Brief summary of the layout composition for UI preview (e.g., '5 cards in a row with icons, 40% empty space on left')

accessibilityNotes.description: Accessibility considerations applied: contrast ratio, color-blind safety, text readability

searchGrounding.description: Google Search grounding details. Present only when search grounding is used.

enabled.description: Whether Google Search grounding was used

queries.description: Search queries used to retrieve factual data

sourcesCited.description: Source names cited in the infographic footer

autoCorrections.description: List of auto-corrections applied due to parameter conflicts or best-practice overrides. Omit if none.

numImages.description: Number of image variations to generate

examples.prompt: Create a minimal modern slide illustration for a presentation titled 'Business Growth 2026'. White background with subtle light gray grid pattern. Abstract geometric composition: a large upward-trending arrow made of gradient blue rectangles (from #93C5FD to #2563EB) positioned on the right third. Small golden circle accents (#F59E0B) at intersection points. Leave the left 40% completely empty as negative space for text overlay. Safe margin 6% on all sides. No characters, no logos. Aspect ratio 16:9, resolution 2K, PNG format.
examples.layoutDescription: Upward arrow graphic on right, 40% empty space on left for text
examples.accessibilityNotes: High contrast blue on white, WCAG AA compliant

examples.prompt: Step 1: Use Google Search to find 'Thailand internet users statistics 2025-2026 by age group percentage'. Step 2: Based on retrieved data, create a modern clean bar chart infographic, 16:9 aspect ratio, 4K resolution. White background. Title at top in bold dark sans-serif. Vertical bars in gradient blue, each labeled with percentage above. Footer with sources.
examples.layoutDescription: Bar chart centered, title top, source footer bottom
examples.accessibilityNotes: High contrast, color-blind safe single-hue palette, direct labels

queries: Thailand internet users by age group percentage 2026

autoCorrections: Model auto-selected: Pro (data visualization with numbers).
Two-step prompt: Google Search grounding enabled.
